# Onboarding and Access Requests

This document describes how a new scientist gets initial access to the
internal tools required for day-to-day work in the laboratory.

## Initial Account Setup

Every new scientist receives a corporate identity on their first day. The
identity is provisioned by IT before the start date. To verify your account
is active, open the internal portal and confirm that your name appears in
the top-right corner. If it does not, contact your local IT support desk.

## Requesting Access to a Lab Application

Lab applications follow a request-and-approval workflow. To request access:

1. Open the internal Access Portal from the corporate homepage.
2. Search for the application by name (for example, the sample-tracking
   tool, the instrument-booking system, or the documentation library).
3. Click "Request access" and complete the short justification form.
4. Submit the request. Your line manager receives an approval notification.
5. Once approved, access typically activates within four working hours.

Do not email IT for access requests. The Access Portal is the only
supported channel, because it produces an auditable record required by
internal compliance.

## Required Training

Some applications gate access on training completion. The most common
prerequisites are the lab safety module and the data-handling module. Both
are available in the learning portal. The system will block your access
request automatically until prerequisites are satisfied.

## Account Issues

If your account is locked or your password expires, use the self-service
portal to reset it. For anything else — for example, a missing role, an
unexpected error message, or an application that refuses to load even
after access has been granted — open an incident in ServiceNow rather than
emailing your local IT contact.
